newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The Central Electoral Bureau issued partial results at 1200 local showing the opposition Democratic Convention (CDR) ahead in the parliamentary race.
* The Interior Ministry said no major incidents which could affect the results of polls had occurred on Sunday.
* Ion Diaconescu, president of the National Peasant Party (PNTCD) said the exit polls conducted by polling institutes IRSOP and IMAS confirmed the polls of the CDR.
He said during a news conference that any difference of more than one percent which might favour the ruling Party of Social Democracy would be viewed as electoral fraud.
